entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Mac OS 26 Supports SHA3 and will be released before .NET 10. Please add support. #50248
  • `dotnet` CLI eats command arguments meant for `fsi` #50247
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]With .NET 10 Preview 7 final build, unable to locate source file as authentication failures for IL symbols #50241
  • [NETSDKE2E][Dev18][Regression] An exceptional condition occurred when lookup symbols. #50240
  • Incorrect Chinese command suggestion in `dotnet workload repair` #50235
  • [dotnet-sdk-10.0.100-rc.1.25409.103] RoslynPad restore with error: NETSDK1226: Prune Package data not found .NETCoreApp 10.0 Microsoft.NETCore.App #50233
  • Investigate performance of .NET watch tests #50228

Closed

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.4xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #50222
  • `dotnet run file.cs` should not pick up implicit build files by default #49826
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #50221

Created

    Area-AspNetCore

    Area-run-file

    Area-run-file
  • Don't create tool manifests in a .config subfolder by default #50242

    arch-wasm, Area-Workloads, 10.0.1xx

  • Test terminal logger with file-based apps #50187

    Area-run-file
